marketplace.name: Catalyst Marketplace
marketplace.description: Private agent marketplace for cornelha — orchestration patterns, skills, and templates for AI coding agents

plugins.name: Catalyst
plugins.description: Ticket orchestration pattern — fan out, reduce, verify, synthesize. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Codex CLI, Copilot, OpenCode, and Pi.
plugins.author: cornelha

install.copilot-cli: copilot plugin marketplace add https://github.com/cornelha/catalyst && copilot plugin install catalyst
